objective: rank accuracy, no odds, EV, stakes or payouts in training, selection or metrics
evaluation_role: already inspected historical periods; never unseen or forward
labels: exactly one finisher at each rank 1,2,3; top-three dead heats reported separately, no arbitrary tie breaks
cohort: all complete eligible fields, independent of final-odds availability; isolated unlinked runners retained
winner_pick: argmax P(first), horse number tie break
top3_set_pick: three largest P(first)+P(second)+P(third), horse number tie break
ordered_pick: most probable joint ordered triple, horse number lexicographic tie break
primary_metric: number of actual top-three horses captured by top3 set / (3 * races)
mean_rank_log_loss: mean of -log marginal probability assigned to actual first, second and third
promotion: research only; compare frozen selected candidate without tuning on 2025/2026; no automatic live activation
source_time: 2/7 day historical assumptions; current going and carried weight remain masked
